title: Nifty 8/10 trade: Bull call spread 25300/25450 (23 Nov) 11:48
summary: Nifty held above the 25,300 wall for two snapshots with call writers covering and fresh put writing behind. Debit about 72.
body_md: BUY 25300 CE @ ~166, SELL 25450 CE @ ~94 (23 Nov). Net cost ~72 (Rs 4,680/lot, max loss). Target value 110 (Nifty ~25,430), stop value 45 or Nifty below 25,280. Max profit 78. Breakeven 25,372. Score 8/10: OI 3, learner 1, trend 1, reward/risk 1, room 1, wall 1. Time exit at the 14:48 check. Analysis only, not trading advice.
